## MYCOPLASMA PNEUMONIAE
Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See
diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.
## Preferred treatment
## Inpatient

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 to 14 days ($) [DI]](psjzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-q12h)
Alternative
Intolerance to doxycycline and azithromycin
[Levofloxacin 500 mg PO q24h for 5 days ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-levoflox-500mg-po-q24h)
## Outpatient

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 to 14 days ($) [DI]
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid-7ds)
Alternative
[Azithromycin 500 mg PO x 1 ($) on day 1, then 250 mg PO QD ($) for 4 days](psozid2-azith-500mg-po-once-then-250mg-po-qday-x4ds)
Non-VA order for above
Intolerance to doxycycline and azithromycin
[Levofloxacin 500 mg PO QDay for 5 days ($) [R,DI]](psozid2-levofloxacin-5ds-500mg-po-qday)
Non-VA order for above
